classification: The generated overlay schedules its retry after the failed child USBH node is recycled, but that is not sufficient to prove the external-hub driver's own control endpoint is idle. The immediate downstream reset/status operation overlaps a hub control transfer, the hub request returns ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE, and hub teardown reaches usbh_dev_close with num_ctrl_xfers_inflight nonzero. This is a repeatable boot loop and the exact candidate is revoked.
corrective_action: First restore a stable controller-first image with downstream enumeration retries disabled. Do not retry at the ext_port recycle callback. Any future attempt must be deferred through the external-hub action queue only after its control transfer completion and must have an independent boot-loop-safe gate; otherwise leave the controller unsupported through this hub and continue OS work on the stable image.
